method_source: code/models.py; continuous-response adaptation, not an original count-task reproduction

decoded_pair.role: strong public-RGB instrument-decoder reference; different representation, not equal perceptual/parameter budget

train_source: same original256 training and64 validation families per draw; identical frozen SigLIP2 dense features and9 target labels; train-only normalization; no extra pre-action/state/gate labels
adaptation: current canonical+protected-witness architecture, projected SigLIP2 tokens, prefix0:6, canonical calibration0 plus repair/post6:12;3 action-query states64wide and3 load responses each. Continuous standardized response MSE replaces categorical CE/CDF; equal-query and surviving-query contrast loss uses existing post-outcome labels only; pre-action auxiliary loss omitted for all arms. This is a prespecified continuous-response adaptation, not a byte-identical old count-task reproduction, oblique operator, active test policy or world model.
matching: same task training data/targets, encoder/cache,1200epochs/9600updates,2LRsearch, seeds/sample order, AdamW and validation standardized response MSE. Existing exact plain/paired fits reused, no retraining/tuning. Shared input projection initialized identically; full architecture parameters/FLOPs not claimed identical. tf_scope isolates objective vs architecture.
data_protocol: same old generator/ranges, fresh base tuples excluding ALL original train/validation/test and both new draws; three matched panels share new families. Physically equivalent post-repair states may recur intentionally; family-disjoint does not mean every effective state unique. Original test data are development evidence, excluded from confirmation.

decision.scope: fixed simulation utility without abstention; not real safety standard

selection: earliest minimum validation standardized response MSE within1200epochs, then best of same2LR, ties smallerLR; all newfits and reusedfits frozen before ANY confirmation-model predictions
secondary_strong_reference: decoded_pair; report explicitly whether any visual gain also beats this strongest prior ordinary readout reference; gate cannot support a broad best-method claim without it

pilot_continue_gate.rule: For BOTH controls and BOTH heldout operations: >=10% lower mean realized repair regret, at least5/6 draw-seed cells nonworse regret, and family-cluster bootstrap upper bound of regret difference<0. Safety noninferiority point differences<=registered margins for each operation and no more than1/6 draw-seed cells exceeding those margins. Bootstrap averages technical seeds first and resamples physical families within draw using same family indices across arms/operations;98.75% upper bounds adjust4 planned regret contrasts. Descriptive pilot screen, not general safety/novelty proof. Otherwise STOP_NO_EXTRA_BENEFIT_IN_THIS_PILOT. No claim of universality or architecture necessity; only extra benefit in declared simulation.

empty_population_policy: Inherited diagnostic ratios may encode empty denominator as0; no benefit gate can pass if any heldout unsafe,robust-unsafe,equivalent or protected population is empty. Such case is INCONCLUSIVE_EMPTY_POPULATION.
